title: Subsystem-Coupling Error Enums (The Dependency Magnet)
pattern: Defining a single, centralized global error enumeration or class that lists the specific error variants of all unrelated subsystems in the project.
why_bad: Violates the Open/Closed Principle. The central enum becomes a "dependency magnet": if a low-level module needs a new specific error variant, the global error file must be modified, triggering recompilation and redeployment of all unrelated modules in the system. [24, Chapter 3, "The Error.java Dependency Magnet"]
detection: An error enum or class imported by 5+ distinct, logically unrelated modules where many variants are only relevant to a single specific subsystem.
counterexample: Highly cohesive, small utility libraries with a single core purpose.
source: *Robert C. Martin - Clean Code*, Chapter 3, "The Error.java Dependency Magnet" [24]
